scenarios.title: National - satisfaction decline
scenarios.blurb: The full dataset. A sustained 11-week drop in customer satisfaction.
scenarios.headline: Customer satisfaction fell 0.324 (4.23 to 3.90). Leading cause: Delivery performance degraded, and that degradation drove the satisfaction drop.

scenarios.title: Parana - ambiguous evidence
scenarios.blurb: A real movement the evidence cannot attribute to a single cause.
scenarios.headline: Customer satisfaction moved significantly (-0.952), but the evidence cannot identify a single cause.

scenarios.title: Goias - normal variation
scenarios.blurb: A dip that looks alarming on a dashboard and is statistically ordinary.
scenarios.headline: No investigation warranted: Customer satisfaction is within normal variation.

scenarios.title: Para - normal variation
scenarios.blurb: A dip that does not persist. Detection needs a sustained run, not one extreme week.
scenarios.headline: No investigation warranted: Customer satisfaction is within normal variation.

scenarios.title: Average order value - restricted
scenarios.blurb: A confidential KPI. The operations reader is told what is withheld, not shown a redacted number.
scenarios.headline: Average order value moved significantly (-67.233), but the evidence cannot identify a single cause.

scenarios.title: Delivery time - second KPI
scenarios.blurb: A different KPI over the same sources, at the same grain.
scenarios.headline: Delivery time rose 4.801 (11.95 to 16.75). Leading cause: Delivery performance degraded, and that degradation drove the satisfaction drop.
